pages.summary: The invisible, collisionless portal surface used by Mysticism's registered Elemental Realm portals.
details: Entities touching the portal surface are handed to Mysticism's dimension-transition logic. The reviewed class routes travel from the Overworld into the Elemental Realm and handles the return path through its configured destination logic.

The block is waterloggable, has no collision, uses no loot table, and reports an invisible render shape. It should be understood as portal infrastructure rather than a normal decorative or survival-harvested block.

pages.summary: A replaceable glass field block tracked by the Nightmares Cadence time-acceleration handler.
details: Placement and removal notify the Cadence time-tick handler, identifying this as implementation support for Cadence's accelerated-time field rather than an ordinary building block.
The reference build gives it a vanilla glass model, no occlusion, and replaceable behavior. No conventional crafting recipe or survival acquisition path was verified.

pages.summary: An ownership-aware doorway that connects a player with the private space created by Domicile.
details: The block stores owner and exterior-location data in its block entity. Its interaction and collision logic check the Domicile skill, apply a teleport cooldown, and move an eligible player between the exterior door and the owner's Domicile.
The release uses vanilla oak-door textures. No conventional crafting recipe was verified; the block belongs to the Domicile system.

pages.summary: The trapdoor form of the Domicile entrance, with the same ownership and return-travel checks.
details: The block uses Domicile ownership data and a teleport cooldown to connect an eligible player with the correct private space or exterior return point.
The release uses vanilla oak-trapdoor textures. No conventional crafting recipe was verified; it is registered as part of the Domicile system.

pages.summary: A non-occluding ice-textured support block registered for Gabriel's frost mechanics.
details: The reviewed implementation provides custom player-destruction behavior and glass-like sound and visibility properties. Its naming and registration tie it to Gabriel, Lord of Patience.
No conventional crafting recipe or survival acquisition path was verified in the reference artifact, so this entry does not present it as a player-crafted block.

pages.summary: An invisible lattice block registered as implementation support for Nightmares' Stasis field.
details: The release models this block with Minecraft's structure-void model and gives it replaceability and special placement checks. It functions as field infrastructure, not visible decorative geometry.
No conventional crafting recipe or survival acquisition path was verified in the reference artifact.
